registration.method: Esri World Imagery z17/z18 tiles composed by ribbingsforsbuild/sat-crop.mjs. The mapping local -> EPSG:3006 -> WGS84 -> tile is computed per point with the repo's own Krüger series, so a tile's coordinates ARE its georeference and there is no registration fit to drift. Reading error is the eye against calibrated 100/200 m gridlines: about ±8 m at z18, ±15 m at z17.
registration.checks: The model's break-geometry water rings, OSM roads and hole-3 green pond all land on their imagery counterparts within reading error; the provisional hole lines land on mown corridors.

corrections: The provisional driving-range ellipse in build-course.mjs (centred about [124,-356]) lies on open lake water in the imagery. The real practice ground is the mown block between the hole-9 and hole-1 corridors south of the clubhouse; the range trace below replaces it.

OSM's ele=66.9 on the Skagern relation disagrees with the Lantmäteriet break geometry (69.3) and with the laser-flat open-water reading of the committed vista heightfield (69.35 at [4000,-3000] and [3000,-4000]). The laser level 69.3 is authoritative.

range.prov: the practice field east of the 1st, MEASURED as the open ground the model does not otherwise claim: not forest in the tree-cover raster, not water, not inside a green/fairway/tee/bunker ring, not within 25 m of a hole line, not within 8 m of a road, track or path — the component containing a seed read off the OWNER’S OWN MARK on the app overhead (converted through the clubhouse, parking and manor footprints visible in the same frame), opened 2 m, closed 3 m, simplified to 2 m. 40,163 m2 over x 504-715, z -432..-172, bounded by the estate track north, the treeline east, the 1st’s corridor west and the wood south (trace-practice.mjs 2026-09-05). It replaces a 6,541 m2 strip of DORMANT ground between the 9th and the 1st, 180 m west, which an earlier pass classified as the range because it was the most striking thing in the capture and the eye-traced ring lay near it: a dormant strip here is a hayfield. The club’s own overview agrees with the owner — registered on its nine numbered discs the map is rotated -149 deg, and its DRIVING RANGE and OVNINGSOMRADE labels then fall east and south-east of KLUBBHUS.

sourceRing.note: the eye-traced ring this replaced, kept so trace-practice.mjs can state the correction on a rerun

range.baysNote: NOT measured: a tee line is a built platform, but this pasture is flat everywhere (5,719 of 11,822 cells at the north end read flat to 0.12 m over 5x5, 3,787 at the south), so the bench test that worked on the dormant strip identifies nothing here. The engine’s own rule stands — the bays are the end of the field you walk to from the clubhouse, which is the north end, and the shot line runs south down the field away from the clubhouse and the 1st.

refusedPracticeGreens.finding: refused: excess green 54 inside against 47 in its collar (contrast 7, below every surveyed green) and the laser reads 0.37 m over 5x5 with a track crossing it; the grower refuses this centre. A scan of the whole clubhouse quarter for green-like discs (contrast >= 18, ExG >= 95, spread <= 0.37) finds no second green anywhere near it, so it is dropped rather than moved.
